node.title: Re: how check the first release of a new operand?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: One more very simple way to do this that I regularly use is to install a bunch of Perl versions using [https://perlbrew.pl/|perlbrew] and then run a simple test using e.g. perlbrew exec perl -wMstrict -e 'my $x="foobar"; $x=~s/^foo\Kbar$/x/; die unless $x eq "foox"'. This will allow you to very quickly test how code behaves on different Perl releases. (If you wanted to dig much deeper for the development history, you could [id://11110663|bisect] the source code.)
